facts.text: A Cyber Security Officer shall confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective before revenue operation is recommended.

facts.label: confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective
revenue operation is recommended

facts.before: confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective

facts.subject: Operational rehearsal
facts.text: Operational rehearsal shall use realistic degraded scenarios including radio coverage loss, failed train initialization, controller switchover, interlocking unavailability, and control center workstation failure.

facts.label: use realistic degraded scenarios

facts.subject: Line Traffic Controller
facts.text: The rehearsal shall demonstrate that the Line Traffic Controller can maintain safe service regulation while the Revenue Train Operator follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions.

facts.label: maintain safe service regulation
follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions

facts.subject: Acceptance for revenue service
facts.text: Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.

facts.subject: readiness review authority
facts.text: No open defect shall be accepted for revenue service unless its operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact have been assessed and approved by the readiness review authority.

facts.label: assessed and approved operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact

facts.subject: management
facts.text: Final entry into revenue service shall occur only after management confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place for sustained operation.

facts.label: confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place
Final entry into revenue service
